page.layout: One centred title page, one printed page. Top to bottom: the title block in roman and italic type, the engraving of a tree with a banner and a figure, then the imprint and date centred below.

main_text.l: L. A. M. M. D. & Philosophiæ in illustri Academia
Ad diem 4. Maji, Ante & post meridiem loco solito.

page.notes: The engraving shows a tree with spreading leaves and a standing robed figure at its right, on a grassy ground. A banner curls across the lower left of the tree and carries the words "NON SOLU", the last letters of which are unclear on the scan, so the banner reading is marked [?]. The date is printed in the old reversed-C form, cIↄ IↄC LXIX, and is given as MDCLXIX. The handwritten "20." at the top right is not printed and is left out. Faint mirrored text from the reverse side (show-through) is not transcribed.
